title: plantago durvillei subsp. mollior
intro: Plantago durvillei subsp. mollior, commonly known as New Zealand Plantain, is a species of flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from digestive issues, inflammation, and skin irritations. The health benefits of New Zealand Plantain include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
